title: Same human is Cockpit Admin in prod AND dev
description: Separation-of-duties: deploy access to production should not be combined with experimental access in dev/sandbox.

title: Same human can deploy MTAs to prod AND dev
description: Deploy rights in production should be a separate human from deploy rights in dev to avoid accidental cross-environment pushes.

title: Same human is both Admin and Auditor
description: Auditors must not have admin rights — defeats the purpose of independent audit.
